title: Transfer BHI to Lysis Buffer
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Verify pipette attachment
steps.instruction: Confirm that the P300 Multi‑Channel pipette (P300‑Multi) is correctly mounted on the robot for the protocol.

steps.title: Load labware onto deck
steps.instruction: Place the Fisherbrand 2‑20 µL tip rack in slot 1, the source Simport Scientific 500 µL tubes in a custom holder in slot 2, and the destination Simport Scientific 500 µL tubes in a custom holder in slot 3.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, specify the pipette mount (left or right) and the number of samples to transfer (choose a value between 1 and 96).

steps.title: Generate protocol file
steps.instruction: Enter the chosen parameters and download the generated protocol file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as described in the deck map (tip rack in slot 1, source tubes in slot 2, destination tubes in slot 3).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 Run App, perform calibration of the tip rack, source tubes, destination tubes, and the P300‑Multi pipette according to the app’s instructions.

steps.title: Execute transfer protocol
steps.instruction: Start the run by pressing “Run”; the robot will transfer BHI from the source tubes to the lysis buffer in the destination tubes as programmed.
